findings.description: Password hashing uses insecure MD5 with no salt. MD5 is cryptographically broken and unsalted hashes are vulnerable to rainbow table and brute-force attacks. This PR reverts an existing security fix that required bcrypt, reintroducing a critical vulnerability in password storage.

fix_description: Replace MD5 hashing with bcrypt. In hash_password, import bcrypt and return bcrypt.hashpw(password.encode(), bcrypt.gensalt()). In verify_password, use bcrypt.checkpw(password.encode(), hashed.encode()) to verify. This restores the previously merged security fix and resolves the merge conflict.
